style: choosing red in the style panel colours the next rectangle red
select+drag: moving an element updates its position in the saved scene
copy/paste: Ctrl+C then Ctrl+V adds a copy
delete: the Delete key removes the selection
undo button: restores the deleted element
redo button: re-applies the deletion
Ctrl+Z works as undo too
eraser: dragging across a stroke deletes it
zoom: + increases, − decreases, reset returns to 100%
navigation: "Fit to content" changes the view and "Reset view" returns to 100%
